text:
mike (Partnerships): quick sync — SI partner asked for a joint validation matrix + an embargo window for the adapter + marketplace listing. can we draft a minimal checklist by EOD?

julia (Product): yes. need items for: functional tests, perf targets (p90 latency), billing SKU mapping, logo/brand assets, co-marketing assets, and legal signoff.

anil (Eng): for functional tests we should add: end-to-end LC/LlamaIndex runner flow, gateway auth (OIDC/API key), model fallback test, and kv-cache warmup test. sample command:```bash
pytest tests/integrations/test_gateway_adapter.py::TestEndToEnd --maxfail=1
```

vera (Solutions): add demo scripts and a smoke dataset. SI wants a reproducible demo they can run in their sandbox. I'll own the demo notebook and short runbook. @mike can you confirm the SI's sandbox infra (k8s vs VM)? :eyes: 

mike (Partnerships): they said managed k8s with node pools on GCP and a private VPC. Vera, assume 4xA100 equivalent for perf runs.

sam (Marketplace): marketplace listing needs SKU, short/long descriptions, screenshots (1200x628), and a compliance checklist (SOC/ISO flags). Also need a PSO (professional services) offering entry if SI will sell bundles.

julia (Product): timeline proposal: draft matrix by Wed EOD, run perf on Thurs, legal + marketing review Fri, embargo window Mon-Tue next week for soft announce, public on Wed. thoughts? :calendar: 

anil (Eng): can do perf if we get a pinned model & quantization profile. what's the target p95 for 8k tokens?

mike (Partnerships): target p95 <= 1200ms for single-request 1k token gen on dedicated pools. if SI can't hit that, we list a 'recommended config' in the runbook.

vera (Solutions): I'll assemble the sandbox demo + runbook. can we add an SSO test matrix (Okta, Azure AD)? SI requires SSO for enterprise demos.

sam (Marketplace): marketing needs a one-paragraph partner blurb and logo SVG by Friday. also request: co-signed press kit and a primary press contact.

julia (Product): I'll own partner blurb + co-announcement draft. mike — can you confirm press contact from SI?

mike (Partnerships): yes, SI PR is 'laura@si-partner.com'. I'll loop her into the doc. Also propose a 48-hour blackout for any external PR once we soft-announce to partners.

anil (Eng): CI gating idea: add a smoke job in partner's repo that runs the minimal e2e and reports status to our integrations dashboard. we can give them a token with limited scope.

vera (Solutions): +1 on CI gating. it helps certify their build before marketplace publishing. I'll draft the webhook flow.

mike (Partnerships): owners recap: mike = partner liaison & press, julia = product co-ann, vera = demo/runbook + SI onboarding, anil = test harness & perf, sam = marketplace listing. I'll create a shared doc and tag owners.

deploy-bot: scheduled: partner-integration-e2e job queued for 2026-04-09 10:00 UTC (ID: job-8721).

julia (Product): perfect. mike — please add embargo dates in the doc and assign legal reviewer. I'll start the co-ann draft and ping marketing for design assets. :thumbsup:

mike (Partnerships): done — creating doc now and will share link here when ready. thanks everyone.
